panels.title: Model tokens by team (all agents, through the gateway)
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| summarize Tokens = sum(Sum) by Team = tostring(Properties["Team"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

panels.title: Tokens by team, agent and environment (chargeback)
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| summarize Tokens = sum(Sum) by Team = tostring(Properties["Team"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"]), Environment = tostring(Properties["Environment"])
| order by Tokens desc

panels.title: Agent runs by outcome (ok, blocked, error)
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.agent.runs"
| summarize Runs = sum(Sum) by Outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

panels.title: Refused inputs by reason and agent
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.agent.runs" and tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "blocked"
| summarize Runs = sum(Sum) by Reason = tostring(Properties["blocked_reason"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| order by Runs desc

panels.title: Agent run time in seconds (average and worst)
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.agent.run.duration"
| summarize AvgSeconds = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), MaxSeconds = max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

panels.title: Error rate by agent (%)
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.agent.runs"
| summarize Errors = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "error"), Runs = sum(Sum) by Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| extend ErrorPct = round(100.0 * Errors / Runs, 2)
| order by ErrorPct desc

panels.title: Human approvals: requested vs decided, by tool
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ("agentkit.approvals.requested", "agentkit.approvals.decided")
| summarize Count = sum(Sum) by Metric = Name, Tool = tostring(Properties["tool"]), Decision = tostring(Properties["decision"])

panels.title: Knowledge searches by outcome (unavailable = users got no documents)
panels.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.knowledge.searches"
| summarize Searches = sum(Sum) by Outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

alerts.title: Model token spend spike
alerts.description: More than 2M model tokens through the gateway in an hour. Check the dashboard's 'Tokens by team, agent' for the source.
alerts.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| summarize Value = sum(Sum)

alerts.title: Prompt-injection attempts spike
alerts.description: More than 20 inputs refused as prompt injection in 15 minutes: likely a probing campaign.
alerts.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.agent.runs" and tostring(Properties["blocked_reason"]) == "prompt_injection"
| summarize Value = sum(Sum)

alerts.title: Agent error rate above 5%
alerts.description: More than 5% of agent runs failed in 15 minutes (only counted with at least 20 runs, so a quiet hour doesn't page anyone).
alerts.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.agent.runs"
| summarize Errors = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "error"), Runs = sum(Sum)
| extend Value = iff(Runs >= 20, 100.0 * Errors / Runs, 0.0)

alerts.title: Approvals piling up
alerts.description: More than 10 more approvals requested than decided in 4 hours: approvers may not be seeing the cards.
alerts.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name in ("agentkit.approvals.requested", "agentkit.approvals.decided")
| summarize Requested = sumif(Sum, Name == "agentkit.approvals.requested"), Decided = sumif(Sum, Name == "agentkit.approvals.decided")
| extend Value = Requested - Decided

alerts.title: Knowledge search failing closed
alerts.description: Document search returned 'unavailable' more than 5 times in 15 minutes (Search, Graph or permissions): users are getting answers without documents.
alerts.kql:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "agentkit.knowledge.searches" and tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "unavailable"
| summarize Value = sum(Sum)
